annotations.text:
Tap the shutter repeatedly - it spells H, E, L, L, then deliberately fails on the 5th, then O.

The 5th capture is the abstain state: confidence 42% falls under the 61% cut-off, so nothing is added.

Tweak chips above the frame: drag Threshold up to ~0.95 to make every capture abstain, or down to 0.3 to make it never abstain.

The 61% here is the ViT-Small cross-corpus result, which is the only model that has actually been through the honest test.

DeiT III's 94.6% is a validation score, not a test score. The panel says so rather than quoting 94.6% at a user as if it were real-world accuracy.
